findings.finding: 'a wall standing at no place' is 'nowhere' re-worded and a reader cannot follow it; 'no wall stands anywhere' is better said by is-not.

Each candidate failing, observing is-not sustaining: one same test returning its last observing, a 0, not changing, an exhausting of bi-coupling showing, and a wall is-not standing at any place.

findings.proposed_new: Uniqueness is-not concluding and is-not persisting. A self takes it again with each observing, and between observings a fixing is-not setting. Existing and possibling go with each one: an observing sustaining a thousand times sustains with a next by a self testing it there, and its prior sustaining is-not that testing.

findings.finding: 'uniqueness is' for 'uniqueness sustains' makes the one-candidate case a stronger claim (uniqueness existing outright) than the old local sustaining with that observing.
findings.proposed_new: One test, three observings, and that test goes on between them. One candidate sustaining: uniqueness sustains. Two or more sustaining: uniqueness is-not there. Each candidate failing: observing is-not sustaining, an exhausting and a value-death a self is observing.

findings.finding: Value lost: the plain claim that a historical trail is not re-tested is gone; 're-testing ... apart from it' is unclear.

A self is-not re-testing a historical trail for being historical: the trail's consequence is a current observing.

findings.finding: Observing stronger than cited: 'an ocean wayfinder' generic, 'small island far away' (Tahiti is not said small), 'finds which atoll' instead of identifying the island reached; Pacific wayfinders sailing for Tahiti, Tuamotu atolls, are dropped.
findings.proposed_new: After each observing a self brings a further test to that observing: could another stand here, surviving as this one survives. Pacific wayfinders sailing for Tahiti aim first at a band of Tuamotu atolls about 400 miles wide, identify the island they reach, and go on to Tahiti, about 170 to 180 miles further: many standing, and a further test with each.

findings.finding: 'apart from a weaker or a partial same-existing: a same-existing at none' cannot be followed and loses 'at all'; 'whose each inversion' is ungrammatical.
findings.proposed_new: A concern that a concept may be otherwise inverts its concept and waits on whether its inversion floats. A living same-existing inverts three ways, and each inversion is a not-same-existing: a point alone, a landing, a store, each a same-existing not possibly existing. Concept-inverting finds each inversion a not-concept: it is-not a weaker same-existing, is-not a partial same-existing, and is-not a same-existing at all. A concept whose inversions are each a not-concept floats possibly existing and unique, its concerns resolving by inversions floating as not-concepts.

findings.finding: 'testing is its other' is unclear ('other' is a self's other here) and softens 'not testing'; 'as' for 'where' can read as 'because' or 'while'.
findings.proposed_new: Concept-inverting is resolving, and testing is a separate move. A test grades strong or weak, a floor it lands on; concept-inverting resolves is-or-is-not, an inversion a possibly existing concept or a not-concept, all-or-none. A concept floats possibly existing and unique with its inversions each a not-concept, and floats among others with an inversion a possibly existing concept, and concept-inverting co-chains a concern to its resolving, all-or-none.

findings.finding: 'Resolving is is-or-is-not' is clumsy ('A self resolves' is clearer); 'a resolving at none' is a floating negation; fruit fly 'each turn about 90 degrees' is stronger than 'saccades ~90 degrees' and drops alternating with straight segments as stated.
findings.proposed_new: A self resolves is-or-is-not, floorless. Resolving is a self's own parity, its next, a self discovering it with a bi-coupling, a bounding-zeroing a bi-coupling reaches, is-or-is-not and free of a magnitude. A floor lands resolving, a threshold, a count or a magnitude an observing settles on, and a landing observing observes always-is or always-is-not, and is-not a resolving. Resolving floats floorless, a self's own parity with each bi-coupling, inverting with each momentary. A fruit fly flies straight segments alternating with saccades, each about 90 degrees in under 50 ms, all or none, left or right.

findings.finding: 'This is the geodesic method's aiming': 2.4 gives finding each is-not and aiming to a self going on with the method, not to the method; also 'resolving concludes' sits against 2.4's aiming that goes on one at a time.
findings.proposed_new: A concern resolves as its is-not empties. Each concern that a thing may be otherwise co-chains to its inversion, and as its inversion is a not-concept a concern resolves, its is-not emptying. Resolving concludes by an is-not emptying, a parity floating to is as its is-not finds each form not possibly existing, floating between existing and possibling, a changing is or is not with each sharing. An is-not emptying concludes it, a resolving, and a floor concluding it is a landing. This is a self's aiming with the geodesic method, 2.4: from each is-not to is.

findings.finding: 'all concern' became 'each concern', which parts from 'a closing total' and 'an all to exhaust' in the same passage; 'an all to exhaust at none' is clumsy. Note: Naming v392 2.4 and the kit list still-possibling as released, though the brief says not-yet is said still-possibling.
findings.proposed_new: Exhausting all concern is an equilibria concept, a closing total resolving floats free of. A self discovers a concern it is still-possibling to observe, and resolving reaches it then, a possibling going on open. Resolving lives between existing and possibling, concerns a self is observing resolving and a possibling going on, an all to exhaust is-not, a changing is or is not with each sharing. Resolving is floorless, is-or-is-not, an is-not emptying with existing and a possibling floating open.

findings.proposed_new: A self observes valuable things as it observes each thing: it stops sorting and observes each thing it reaches. It is-not deciding which is which, and one same observing observes waste and signal, each a sorting's word, one same way, together, a sorting is-not reaching them. Marshallese navigators lie in the hull to feel the swells' pitch and roll, an island's shadow a change in the main swell's rhythm or several swells hitting at once; in an octopus's sucker, chemosensory cells fire continuously, only during direct contact, and mechanosensory cells fire only at the start of contact.

findings.proposed_new: A self takes a parity and leaves an object. A leaving is-not a regress reaching for a smaller thing: a between is a nothing, is-not decomposing to smaller betweens, and is-not made by anything, and a freeing of it is lengthless. A parity with a detector, a parity with a residue, a parity with a ledger, a parity with a pump: each complete with its own surface, each is-not a floor for a next, and each is-not wanting one.
